Comlink Cursor: added the row for [[Admiral Motti, Battlestation Coordinator (V)]] after [[Admiral Motti (V) (Dark)]], moved from Virtual Block 6. VirtualBlock1.pdf prints it as 02E (page 2, Dark Side). Cards Total 173 → 174. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=610868#p610868 forum p=610868] (JediJer, 30 March 2011; Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020194139/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p610868.html Internet Archive]) reported in 2011 that the card list had it under Block 6. == Printed slips (October 2026) ==

Slip column added from the official [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf] (Players Committee, official text 7 December 2009; opened Preserved copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf 20261020181626], sha256 0d384102d0f56e11eb19952b3763300f92df6513d1dec16dc6405e029040c8dd). Each cell is a 300 DPI crop of the printed slip (heading plus the cutout beneath the title). Dual-face locations [[Alderaan (Blown Away)]] and [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (V) (Virtual Block 1)|Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (V)]] are shown as printed on the sheet. The objective is two full portrait sides: 0-side Imperial Entanglements (sleeve over Ralltiir Operations (V)) and 7-side No One To Stop Us This Time (sleeve over In The Hands Of The Empire (V)).

[[Merc Sunlet (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)|Merc Sunlet (V)]] is printed as Light Effect 132 on page 9 of the PDF, between Logistical Delay 131 and Nightfall 133. The table had omitted it; Cards Total 174 → 175. The card page is still titled under Virtual Set 3: Revolution. No Holotable GIF is on the wiki, so the Image cell is blank.
